messages:
Maya: Quick sync — I'm kicking off a PRD check-in for the Observability Console non-functional requirements (retention tiers, trace sampling, dashboard perf SLOs). I uploaded the draft: https://redwood.internal/prd/obs-console-nf-1973 :link: Need concise launch acceptance criteria and edge-case list. @Praveen can you validate perf targets?
Praveen: Got it. I'll run the perf matrix tomorrow. Need to confirm p50/p95/p99 for dashboard loads and trace detail expand. Also want to call out concurrent query QPS for large orgs.
Kate: UX heads-up: large trace lists need progressive loading and clear skeleton states. If we keep full-page sync loads it will feel slow. Propose async detail fetch + client-side caching.
Jordan: Storage/cost note — retention tiers must have auto-archive policy. For >90 days keep samples only (1%) by default unless org opts in. Also we need safe defaults for sampling so we don't blow storage on noisy customers.
deploy-bot: PRD updated by Maya (1973456795) — changed "Retention tiers" section.
Maya: Thanks. For launch I want a short, testable checklist: 1) retention tier UI + API deployed and configurable per-org, 2) default sampling policy applied and documented, 3) dashboard median load < 1.2s at 50th percentile for orgs <100k events/mo, 4) trace detail expand P95 < 300ms, 5) migration/rollback plan validated, 6) privacy checks done. Thoughts?
Praveen: Those look good. Suggest tightening the load targets to be environment-specific: dev/staging/prod. Also add throughput tests: sustain 200 concurrent users on a mid-size org. We'll add automated load job: `load-tests/obs-dashboard-sustained` and a p95 SLA gate.
Kate: Edge cases to include in PRD: - traces >10k events (render fallback) - traces with mixed timezones - sessions with missing timestamps - very high-cardinality attributes in trace list (ensure truncation)
Jordan: Add operational acceptance: - retention purge job backfill tested - cross-tenant ACL checks verified - KMS rotation unaffected by archiving - canary to 5% orgs in EU region first. Also need runbook for degraded-storage fallback (read-only mode).
Praveen: Tests to add to acceptance criteria: - fidelity test comparing raw vs sampled traces (metric: how many user-visible regressions allowed <= 1%) - e2e query correctness for multi-segment traces - perf regression job runs every deploy with diffs posted to #eng-releases
Kate: UX decision: export terminology — should we use "Download raw trace" instead of "Export" for clarity? Small copy change but reduces support tickets.
Maya: Good call. I'll update the PRD with the checklist, owners, and test names, and add the canary plan: 5% orgs for 48h then ramp. Owners: Praveen (eng perf/tests), Kate (UX), Jordan (ops/rollout). Please review sections I highlighted by EOD so I can lock scope before Friday's roadmap sync. :calendar: :eyes:
Praveen: Reviewing today.
Kate: Will skim and comment 10:30am PT.
Jordan: I'll validate the backfill and runbook by EOD.
Maya: Awesome — thanks team. I'll post updated PRD link once changes are in.
deploy-bot: Reminder — docs deployment scheduled at 1973456805 to staging.
